(BY SHRI VIRENDRA PAL- DEPUTY ADVOCATE GENERAL )
 This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER Case Diary is perused.
This is the Second application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.
The first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 21/03/2022 passed in MCRC No.6859/2022.

Applicant has been arrested on 06/12/2020 by Police Station- Mungawali, District- Ashoknagar (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.57/2020 for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A & 376(2)(N) of IPC and Sections 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
Prosecution story, in short, is that on 24/02/2020, on the pretext of marriage, applicant- Suraj took the prosecutrix alongwith him and solemnized the marriage with her.
Thereafter, they started living like husband and wife and made physical relation many times.

sentences.text: thereafter, they started talking on mobile phone and liking each other.
On the date of incident, she called the applicant at Nadankhedi and from there, both of them reached at Bunglow Chauraha by Auto.
After that, they reached at Bhopal from Nadankhedi where they solemnized the marriage and applicant made physical relation with the prosecutrix with the consent of her.
On the basis of aforesaid, crime has been registered against the applicant.
She was sent for medical examination.
Applicant was arrested on 06/12/2020 and after investigation, charge sheet has been submitted.
It is mentioned in the application that the applicant is a youth of 20 years of age and he has falsely been implicated in this case.
He is in custody since 06/12/2020.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Applicant is the permanent resident of District- Vidisha (M.P.) and there is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On such premise, prayer for grant of bail of the applicant is made.
Learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes a cash security of Rs.25,000/- along with a personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of any default, cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall be forfeited without giving any notice.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for necessary compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
